text.p: The Quick Plot shows a plot of selected fields from Raw Events, such as parameters or return values from Linux Syscall events. This is used by right-clicking on a Raw Event in the Trace View or in the Event Log. Then select "Add to Quickplot" and the field to include.

Raw Events are enabled in the main filter under Raw Data Event Channels and there is also a separate "Raw Events" filter in the Event Log. You may also need to enable support for Raw Events in the Settings (File -> Setting -> Project Settings -> Performance Settings -> Include Raw Events in Trace).
